data.long_meaning: Mafaz is a name of Arabic origin that has deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is derived from the Arabic root 'afz' which means 'to protect' or 'to shield'. This name is also mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-An'am (6:31) as a name of God, signifying His all-encompassing protection and care for His creation.
